acceptance_criteria.criterion: "Dry Run" badge visible in project detail run list for dry-run log files
"Dry Run" badge coexists with "Running" badge for active dry runs
run_start timeline card shows "Dry Run" badge when dry_run: true

summary: Rendered dry-run badge in project-detail.js run list by checking item.is_dry_run and emitting a badge-dry-run span alongside the existing Running badge.
Rendered dry-run badge in run-log.js run_start case by checking entry.dry_run and prepending a badge-dry-run span to the Run started heading.
Added 3 new tests to run-log.test.ts covering dry_run:true, dry_run:false, and dry_run absent cases.
Added 3 new tests to project-detail-runs.test.ts covering dry-run badge, absence when false, and coexistence with Running badge for active dry runs.
All 35 targeted tests pass; 12 pre-existing failures in dialogue-qa.test.ts confirmed unrelated to these changes.

comments.note: In project-detail.js, the badge rendering builds HTML strings inline rather than using a helper function. The pattern (isActive badge + dryRunBadge + run number span) is now repeated conceptually across multiple badge types. A small extractBadges(item, isActive) helper would keep this readable as more badge types are added.

run-log.js uses entry.dry_run (snake_case) while project-detail.js uses item.is_dry_run for the same concept. The field name difference is driven by different API response schemas (log entry vs. log resolver RunEntry), which is intentional per WP-001. The inconsistency is harmless but worth noting in case a future unification pass is considered.

summary: Reviewed dry-run badge implementation in project-detail.js and run-log.js. Both implementations are clean, minimal, and correct. The null-safety check (item && item.is_dry_run) in project-detail.js mirrors the established pattern used by the Running badge. The leading-space dryRunBadge in run-log.js matches the visual-separation convention for inline append in that file. All 3 acceptance criteria are met; 6 tests provide strong coverage across true/false/absent cases and badge coexistence. No blocking issues found.

comments.note: project-detail.js uses inline style="margin-right:6px" on both the Running and Dry Run badges rather than a utility class. Since the Running badge already established this pattern, the change is consistent — but a future .badge + .badge spacing rule in styles.css would eliminate these repeated inline styles.

[documentation-forward] The field name for dry-run flag differs between the two API response shapes: item.is_dry_run in the RunEntry list response (GetRunLogs) vs entry.dry_run in the log-event schema. This split is intentional (different API surfaces), but should be documented in the GUI API surface docs so future contributors understand why the names differ and where each originates.
